title: [spec-gap][R-CCP12-007/011/019/023] ccp12-hopping spec examples/status text regressed vs vectors and code
description: Sweep docs/spec-coverage/appendix-ccp12-hopping.md. (1) spec/appendix-ccp12-hopping.md §3.2 example: hex 0x373854FC wrong (FNV-1a32(0011223344556677||01000000)=926423932=0x37381B7C) and '926423932 MOD 7 = 1 → Result: Channel 2' wrong — MOD 7 = 0 → Channel 1, matching ccp16.json vector synchronized_hop_channel_consistency (channel 1). (2) §4.3b example 'N = MAX(8, 3) = 8' contradicts §4.1 pseudocode (N = NChannels-1 = 7); '<hash value>' placeholder never filled; duplicate '### 4.3' headings need renumbering. (3) §9 quoted vector shows channel 2/expected 2 but ccp16.json has 1/1; ccp16.json was generated with NChannels=3 (documented only in python/tests/test_channel_plan.py:275-277) — state that provenance in the spec or add n_channels to the vector file. (4) §7.1 'Current Status: 8 channels' and §8.2 enhancement 1 stale: US915 plan already has 64 channels + DWELL_TIME dwell_time_ms=400 (python/src/lichen/channel_plan.py:139-150). Fix spec text only; vectors are authoritative per §8.1.
